# Sequence 7: THE PLAN

**Duration:** 00:48:00 (1152 frames, 15 shots) · **REC:** 01:06:35:00 - 01:07:23:00 · **Music:** 7M1 'The Count' (silence > solo piano > low string motif > building determination; the tick motif is introduced)

**Purpose.** Turn defeat into a plan the audience can follow: three anchors, an order, a half-second window, a clock Thanos cannot read, and three teams whose failure is interdependent. Every hero is visibly damaged; nobody has been cleaned up.
